items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: Have you noticed on Lawrence Waltz, the piano, that girl that plays? ... But he has some lovely waltzing on his program.

ctx.x: The pieces, the popular pieces sounded just as fine as the old ones, but they always played with a powerful beat and a variation, you know. Have you ever noticed when, like they're playing on, you're hearing orchestra on television, how they put all that variation on the piano and all. That's not in the piece, but just do that. Have you noticed on Lawrence Waltz, the piano, that girl that plays? She just can put it on. But I don't believe you'd call that ragtime, would you? The way she goes at it. Yeah, you…
